sources.title: Tiny Aya Global model card
sources.evidence: Exact Global card identifies Cohere/Cohere Labs, nominal 3.35B, text input/output, open weights, CC-BY-NC-4.0 and autoregressive Transformer. Its model identifier is tiny-aya-it-global. A 111B sentence in the terms section conflicts with the model-specific size and is apparent copied boilerplate.

sources.title: Tiny Aya: Bridging Scale and Multilingual Depth
sources.evidence: March 2026 developer report identifies Global as the globally balanced instruction-tuned variant. Section 3.1 and Table 2 specify dense decoder-only Transformer, nominal 3.35B total, 8192-token input and output context, and 36 layers. Table 1 describes regional coverage; Section 5.4 evaluates prompted chain-of-thought.

sources.title: Tiny Aya documentation
sources.evidence: Exact tiny-aya-global row gives 3.35B, 8k context/output, 70 languages and global balance. Describes the five-model Tiny Aya family, ordinary Chat API access and downloadable weights.

sources.title: Cohere Labs Launches Tiny Aya, Making Multilingual AI Accessible
sources.evidence: Dated February 17, 2026. Source HTML includes a TinyAya-Global launch section calling it instruction-tuned and globally balanced; datePublished is 2026-02-17T04:00:07.000-05:00. Blog states 67 supported languages, unlike current documentation row reporting 70. Rendered extraction omitted the body, so source HTML was inspected.

sources.title: Exact Tiny Aya Global Hub metadata and chat template
sources.evidence: Public metadata identifies Cohere2ForCausalLM and exposes the complete default chat template. It renders system/user/assistant text, starts generation inside START_RESPONSE, and has no tools/tool_calls or thinking branch. Metadata reports 3349227520 BF16 elements; this aggregate was not independently audited against tensor headers.

sources.title: CC-BY-NC 4.0 License with Acceptable Use Addendum
sources.evidence: License linked by the exact Global model card is CC-BY-NC 4.0 with an acceptable-use addendum.

sources.title: Basic usage of tool use (function calling)
sources.evidence: Describes tool use for the Command family. It contains no exact Tiny Aya Global capability declaration; generic Chat endpoint support does not establish support for this variant.

sources.title: Tiny Aya En-Thinker model card
sources.evidence: Later separate checkpoint explicitly supports dual-mode reasoning using enable_thinking and thinking delimiters. It links Global as a different family member; it does not directly state Global API capability or incapability.

sources.title: Tiny Aya Global raw configuration access attempt
sources.evidence: HTTP 401. Exact raw tokenizer_config.json and chat_template.jinja access attempts also returned 401; no gated files or checkpoint headers were inspected.

name.note: Exact globally balanced variant; distinct from Base, regional variants and later Thinkers.

developer.note: Card explicitly credits Cohere and its Cohere Labs research group.

family.note: Normalized key for the explicitly named Tiny Aya family.

release_date.note: Dated first-party launch explicitly names Global. Hub repository creation on February 13 is not treated as public launch.

open_weights.note: Official weights are distributed with acceptance gating; open weights does not imply unrestricted licensing.

license.note: Preserve the named license and note its acceptable-use addendum.

parameters_b.note: Developer-reported nominal billions. Hub aggregate is consistent with rounding but is not an independent complete learned-parameter count; gated tensor headers were not audited.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately defined active-parameter count is given. Dense architecture alone is not used to equate active and total parameters.

architecture.note: Developer report explicitly specifies dense decoder-only Transformer. Exact Global metadata selects Cohere2ForCausalLM.

context_window.note: Table 2 resolves rounded 8k to 8192 input tokens. Separate output limit is also 8192; do not sum them.

modalities.note: Exact card explicitly specifies text-only input and generated text output.

reasoning.note: Dedicated native/API reasoning mode is unverified. Global template opens direct response and has no thinking branch; prompted reasoning evaluations and separate Thinker modes do not establish an explicit Global negative. Clear baseline false.

tool_call.note: No exact Global-native/API support declaration verified. Template has no tool serialization, and generic Command-family tool use cannot justify baseline true. Clear to unknown rather than assert tested non-support.

description.value: Compact instruction-tuned multilingual model designed to balance performance across languages and regions.
description.note: Removes unsupported numerical precision: launch says 67 supported languages while current documentation says 70; the broad multilingual positioning is consistent.

patch.description: Compact instruction-tuned multilingual model designed to balance performance across languages and regions.

sources.label: Exact Global metadata and chat template

patch.notes: 3.35B is the developer nominal total; active parameters are not separately reported. Raw checkpoint files are gated, and Hub aggregate metadata was not independently counted. First-party language totals differ (67 in launch, 70 in documentation). CC-BY-NC-4.0 includes an acceptable-use addendum. Dedicated reasoning and native/API tool support remain unverified despite a direct-response chat template.

summary: Confirmed Global identity and February 17 launch; added nominal 3.35B, Tiny Aya family and dense architecture, corrected context from 8000 to 8192. Cleared unsupported reasoning/tool flags to unknown. Active count remains undisclosed. Reworded description around consistent positioning, recording conflicting first-party language totals and gated tensor verification limits.
